stem: Plants wilt even though the media remains saturated, and roots show declining condition. What is the strongest first management response?
choices: Add more irrigation because wilting always means drought
Investigate drainage, aeration, and root health before treating the symptom as a water shortage
Ignore the root zone and adjust only canopy lighting
rationale: Wilting can occur when damaged or oxygen-limited roots cannot function normally despite abundant water. Root-zone aeration, drainage, and root condition should be evaluated before adding more water.
